graphic_design.title: CISSA Dean's Cup Campaign

graphic_design.details: A complete branding and visual asset system developed for the University of Ilorin CISSA Dean's Cup. This project included social media fixtures, match day announcements, post-game scorecards, and MVP badges.

graphic_design.title: FYB '26 Event Branding

graphic_design.details: Graduation and final year celebration designs for class of 2026. Includes date reveal templates, ceremony flyer suites, ticket price graphics, and backdrop photo zones.

graphic_design.details: Visual design collateral and slides for the Faculty Awards 2026. Focuses on premium gold accents, clean spacing, and formal grid typography for category announcements.

graphic_design.title: CISSA Owambe Celebration
graphic_design.description: Social media flyer campaign capturing traditional Yoruba outfits, colors, and event details in high-impact typography.
graphic_design.details: A social media flyer campaign celebrating cultural heritage and Yoruba fashion outfits. Includes invitation designs, banner announcements, and guest ticket passes.
